item.title: SD House of Reps passes ban on lab grown meat
item.description: The South Dakota House of Representatives passed HB 1077 Wednesday, sending it to the state senate for further consideration. HB1077 declared lab-grown meat as adulterated food, basically banning it from sale in South Dakota. item.title: Fact Brief: Can South Dakota residents hunt tribal lands?
item.description: (South Dakota News Watch) Though rules differ, several South Dakota reservations allow hunting on tribal lands. The Standing Rock Sioux Tribe, located in north-central South Dakota and parts of North Dakota, allows hunting on its 1.6 million acres.
